table ip docker-bridges {
	map filter-forward-in-jumps {
		type ifname : verdict
		elements = { "docker0" : jump filter-forward-in__docker0,
			     "br-3f2a9c1d7e44" : jump filter-forward-in__br-3f2a9c1d7e44 }
	}

	chain filter-forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy accept;
		iifname vmap @filter-forward-in-jumps
	}

	chain nat-prerouting-and-output {
		fib daddr type local counter packets 0 bytes 0 jump nat-ports
	}

	chain nat-prerouting {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		jump nat-prerouting-and-output
	}

	chain nat-ports {
		iifname != "br-3f2a9c1d7e44" ip daddr 127.0.0.1 tcp dport 3001 counter packets 0 bytes 0 dnat to 172.18.0.2:3000 comment "DNAT"
	}

	chain nat-postrouting-out__br-3f2a9c1d7e44 {
		oifname != "br-3f2a9c1d7e44" ip saddr 172.18.0.0/16 counter packets 0 bytes 0 masquerade comment "MASQUERADE"
	}
}
